The punchline 'I never got called the refuse of the WORLD' has the same self-deprecating shape as stop 1 card 3 ('nobody EVER called me anything that big'). Both jokes compare the name Paul uses with names Papa Dorin was or wasn't called. This repeats a joke idea and punchline shape, and it is not a callback that adds something new.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson. A callback is the one exception, and it adds something new.
